intro: にわたって spreads something over the whole of a span: a long time, a wide area, many pages or many items. It stresses scale: the action or state fills the span from end to end, and the span is felt to be large. Directly before a noun it becomes にわたる.

skills.rule: Span of time, space or number + にわたって: throughout, over the whole of that span; it stresses that the span is large.
skills.explain:
にわたって follows a noun that measures out a range: a length of time (三時間, 二年, 長年), an area (全国, 広い範囲, 町全体) or a count of things (十回, 五百ページ, 多くの分野). The clause after it says what continued or extended over the whole range: 工事は二年にわたって続いた.

The span must be large, or felt to be large. にわたって adds weight, so it suits news, reports and formal speech. A short, ordinary span sounds comically inflated: say 五分間歯を磨いた, not 五分にわたって.

Directly before a noun it becomes にわたる: 長年にわたる研究 (research spanning many years).

The edge: にわたって covers one whole block with no gaps. にかけて gives a loose stretch between two end-points, usually with から (夜から朝にかけて), without stressing that every part was filled. を通じて also means "all through" a period, but also "via" a person or medium.
patterns: [length of time] にわたって [続く / 行う]
[area / range] にわたって [広がる / 被害が出る]

examples.jp: 会議[かいぎ]は三時間[さんじかん]{にわたって}続[つづ]きました。
examples.en: The meeting went on for three hours.

examples.jp: 工事[こうじ]は二年[にねん]{にわたって}行[おこな]われる予定[よてい]です。
examples.en: The construction work is scheduled to run over two years.

examples.jp: 大雨[おおあめ]で、広[ひろ]い範囲[はんい]{にわたって}被害[ひがい]が出[で]た。
examples.en: The heavy rain caused damage over a wide area.

examples.jp: この本[ほん]は五百[ごひゃく]ページ{にわたって}戦争[せんそう]の歴史[れきし]を描[えが]いている。
examples.en: This book traces the history of the war over five hundred pages.

examples.jp: 長年[ながねん]{にわたる}研究[けんきゅう]の結果[けっか]、新[あたら]しい薬[くすり]が開発[かいはつ]された。
examples.en: After many years of research, a new medicine was developed.

contrast.note: にかけて marks a rough stretch between two points, usually with から: 今夜から明日の朝にかけて雨が降る. It is vaguer and does not stress the whole span; weather forecasts use it. A single large block (三年間, 全国) takes にわたって.
を通じて (を通して) also means "all through" a period, with a sense of steady sameness: 一年を通じて暖かい. It also means "via": 友人を通じて知り合った. にわたって stresses size and never means "via".
において gives the setting (会議において発表した: announced at the meeting) and says nothing about length. にわたって measures how far the event extends.

mistakes.bad: 会議[かいぎ]は三時[さんじ]{にわたって}続[つづ]きました。
mistakes.good: 会議[かいぎ]は三時間[さんじかん]{にわたって}続[つづ]きました。
mistakes.note: にわたって needs a length (三時間), not a point on the clock (三時).

mistakes.bad: 長年[ながねん]{にわたって}研究[けんきゅう]が実[みの]を結[むす]んだ。
mistakes.good: 長年[ながねん]{にわたる}研究[けんきゅう]が実[みの]を結[むす]んだ。
mistakes.note: Directly before a noun, にわたって becomes にわたる.

skills.tip: Can you say "over the whole of" this span, and is the span impressively large? Then にわたって.
